text:
Mia Chen: Hey team — onboarding snag. Followed the Node quickstart, set REDWOOD_API_KEY and WORKSPACE_ID, ran the sample app. First call just stalls ~10s then SDK throws a 403 with body saying billing_required. SDK also logs repeated auth refresh attempts (3x) before giving up. Not sure if this is a retry/auth bug or our workspace is actually gated. Anyone seen this exact combo?

Mia Chen: Logs: 
```
[2026-02-10T14:21:03.123Z] DEBUG sdk: start request -> /v1/generate
[2026-02-10T14:21:13.129Z] WARN  sdk: retrying auth refresh (attempt 1)
[2026-02-10T14:21:13.130Z] WARN  sdk: retrying auth refresh (attempt 2)
[2026-02-10T14:21:13.130Z] WARN  sdk: retrying auth refresh (attempt 3)
[2026-02-10T14:21:13.131Z] ERROR sdk: request failed status=403 code=billing_required workspace=wk_abc123
{ "message": "Billing required for workspace", "hint": "Add a billing card or request trial" }
```

Mia Chen: Node snippet I'm using: 
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi' });
```

Cam Patel: @Mia Chen thanks — couple quick checks: 1) can you confirm the API key is for the same workspace_id (wk_abc123)? 2) did you sign up via self-serve or invite? 3) what's the SDK version (npm list @redwood/inference)?

Mia Chen: confirmed api key belongs to wk_abc123. Signed up self-serve with the free tier credits. npm list shows @redwood/inference@0.9.1.

Alex Rivera: quick thought — the hosted API will return billing_required if you hit a billing gate or if the workspace has expired credits. But the 3 auth refresh logs are odd; the client should not be refreshing if the key is static. Are you using an env var rotation helper or a local proxy?

Mia Chen: no proxy, just env var. Also saw the client print: 
`AuthManager: refresh token not found, trying API key fallback` then it still loops.

Jordana Singh: @Mia can you run a curl to isolate SDK vs API? e.g. 
```
curl -s -D- -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"hello"}'
```
and paste response headers+body. If curl gets 403 too it's server-side (billing gate), otherwise SDK bug.

Mia Chen: pasted curl output: 
```
HTTP/2 403
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d

{"error":{"message":"Billing required for workspace wk_abc123","code":"billing_required"}}
```

Cam Patel: OK that confirms workspace is gated. Two likely causes: (A) free credits expired or (B) org needs a billing card. I'll check account state in the admin console. @devex-bot can you surface the workspace billing status for wk_abc123?

devex-bot: Workspace wk_abc123 — status: credits_exhausted, last_credit_grant: 2025-12-01, payment_method: none.

Samir Khan: Adding context — we recently tightened the initial free credit window for self-serve to avoid abuse. If credits_exhausted you'll get billing_required. We should make the SDK error clearer and avoid auth-refresh churn in that path. Filing quick bug: DX-1129 (sdk: avoid auth refresh loop when API key provided and billing_required returned).

Mia Chen: Thanks. Is there a frictionless unblock for my teammate? They need a test call to validate model selection.

Cam Patel: Temporary unblock options: 1) add a payment method to workspace (fastest) 2) request a trial top-up from Growth (I'll ping them) 3) we can spin a short-lived demo workspace and issue a key (Samir can create one with credits). Which do you prefer?

Mia Chen: Demo workspace would be great so we can continue the tutorial without entering billing.

Samir Khan: I created wk_demo_789 and issued key sk_demo_xyz (expires in 24h). DMing keys now.

Mia Chen: Demo key worked, first call success 🎉 — thanks all. Couple follow-ups: 1) can we improve the quickstart docs to show the billing gate behavior and where to check credits? 2) SDK should avoid noisy auth refresh logs when API key is present.

Alex Rivera: Agreed. I'll add a small troubleshooting section to the quickstart about billing_required and include the curl test. Samir — can you own DX-1129?

Samir Khan: Yep I'll own DX-1129. Plan: repro, patch auth manager to short-circuit refresh when static API key present, add better error message for billing_required, and add a short note in the SDK README. ETA EOD tomorrow for a fix + patch release.

Mia Chen: Awesome — closing the loop. Thanks for the quick help :thumbsup:

Cam Patel: filing a tiny docs PR after lunch.\/\/cc @devex

Jordana Singh: marking this thread as resolved for now.
